capabilities: search notes by keyword, semantic meaning, or a hybrid of both
open results at the matching section of each note
index the whole vault or selected folders with automatic incremental updates
filter results by modified date, term matching, and sort order
search YAML property names and values as metadata matches
extras: Desktop only (macOS Apple silicon, Windows x64, Linux x64/ARM64); no mobile support. First enable downloads a ~75-100 MB private Node.js runtime from GitHub and a MiniLM model from Hugging Face, so an internet connection is needed once; notes are never uploaded. Index, model, and runtime are stored outside the vault to avoid sync conflicts with Dropbox, iCloud, and OneDrive. Also installable via BRAT or manually.
problem: Obsidian's core search matches words only, so notes using related terms or similar meaning do not surface, and there is no semantic or hybrid retrieval built in.

relations.evidence: ZVec provides the local keyword and similarity search database.
Transformers.js runs the MiniLM model locally to convert note content into vectors

summary: Local hybrid search plugin that finds notes by keyword (BM25), semantic similarity, or both, with automatic indexing and section-level results.
